perche: Z-C21, finding M5, measured REAL by Z-C21.3 on 28/9/2026 (probe_fixed_relation). The extrusions from contours (estrudi_profilo, ruota_dentata, estrudi_sezione) and the revolve end with BloccaSchizzo (OperazioniSw.cs): after the feature it called RelationManager.AddRelation(object[] of the segments, swConstraintType_FIXED) on the CLOSED sketch, ignored the return and declared the sketch locked. ISketchRelationManager~AddRelation.html: «A sketch must be active for this method to have any effect». The probe built the bridge's own sketch (six CreateLine calls, AddToDB on, closed with InsertSketch(false), extruded 10 mm) and measured four ways: closed sketch and object[] adds 0 FIXED relations; EditSketch and object[] raises RPC_E_SERVERFAULT; EditSketch and SketchSegment[] adds 6. The fix opens the sketch with EditSketch, passes a SketchSegment[], leaves it with InsertSketch(true), rebuilds, and counts the FIXED relations again on the sketch taken from its feature: the sketch is declared locked only when every segment got one, and the count is published as fixed_relations.
il_difetto_che_questo_caso_prende: A sketch declared locked with no relation in it (the old library), a lock that adds fewer relations than segments, and a lock that breaks the part: the volume after the lock must still be the extruded L.
se_resta_verde_sulla_libreria_vecchia: It does not go green on 0.141.0: it stops with a bench error on the missing field misure.fixed_relations, because the old library never read anything back. No field of the old result can show the lie (the lock flag was true both when the relations were there and when they were not), and the document state does not list sketch relations: the 0 FIXED relations of the old call were measured by the probe, case R0.
i_numeri: L 60 x 60, legs 10 thick: 60 x 10 + 50 x 10 = 1100 mm2, extruded 10 mm = 11000 mm3, six lines. Probe, case R2 (EditSketch, SketchSegment[]): AddRelation returns an ISketchRelation, relations 0 -> 6 and FIXED 0 -> 6 read back after InsertSketch(true) and EditRebuild3, status 2 (under constrained) -> 3 (fully constrained), volume 11000 -> 11000, no sketch active at the end. Case R0 (the old call: closed sketch, object[]): return null, FIXED 0 -> 0, status 2 -> 2, and the bridge would have declared the sketch locked.
